content.rendered:
March 7th from 3:30-6:00 pm all four Sherwood
Elementary Schools will be hosting their Kindergarten  Round-Up. 
We welcome all parents and their future students to visit our school
anytime between 3:30-6:00 to tour the school, meet the principal and
kindergarten teachers, take a short bus ride and learn more about what to
expect for your incoming kindergartner. 
Registration packets will be available in our office beginning Monday,
February 5th for the 2018-2019 school year.  Required to complete enrollment you will need
two forms of proof of residence, a birth certificate, and immunization records.  Students must be 5 years old on or before
September 1st, 2018.  If you
need more information, please contact Beccah Wagner, our Family Resource
Coordinator at 503-825-5486, or email her at rwagner@shrewood.k12.or.us.   You are welcome to call our office as well at
503-825-5300.
